Chapter 456 - 456 Arrival; Preaching! (1)

Chapter 456 - 456 Arrival; Preaching! (1)

456 Arrival; Preaching! (1)

Zheng Cong spoke like an elder to a junior, with a superior appearance.

He raised his head as if he was waiting for Lin Fan to nod and bow.

However…

Lin Fan’s expression was calm. He was about to speak.

Not far away, a slightly ear-piercing voice sounded.

“Hu Tian!”

Then, a man in a suit and leather shoes with a slightly raised hairline walked over quickly.

“Hu Tian, long time no see!” he said with a smile.

Before Hu Tian could say anything, Zheng Cong said, “Wang Haoran?”

Wang Haoran was also Hu Ting’s classmate at Jiangbei University back then.

Of course, he and Zheng Cong were also university classmates.

“Zheng Cong?”

Wang Haoran’s attention was all on Hu Tian.

At this moment, he heard a voice beside him and turned to look.

“We haven’t seen each other since we graduated from university. I didn’t expect to meet you here today. By the way, why did you come to school today?” Zheng Cong said.

As he spoke, he could not help but lean his body toward Hu Tian.

That appearance… It was as if he was saying, ‘Don’t even think about touching Hu Tian!’

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran were former classmates, so the former knew the latter very well. Or rather, all the male students in the class had feelings for Hu Tian.

How could Wang Haoran not see through Zheng Cong’s actions and intentions?

However, he saw that Hu Tian did not react at all, nor did she have any intimate actions with Zheng Cong.

He immediately understood that this was just Zheng Cong’s wishful thinking.

“Isn’t it almost graduation season?” Wang Haoran smiled casually. “The employment environment isn’t very good now, and I happen to be the deputy director of Feitu Network, so I’m quite capable. Therefore, I came to help my alma mater solve the employment problems of my juniors.”

After saying this, a faint smug expression appeared on his face as he slowly looked at Hu Tian.

It was as if he was saying, ‘Hu Tian, I’m amazing, right?’

“Zheng Cong, what are you doing here?”

“Oh, I’m also here to help my juniors find jobs.”

As if to verify their words, a loud voice sounded not far away.

“Director Wang, Director Zheng, you’re here. The other entrepreneurs and school leaders are in lecture hall 3.” A round-faced man walked over quickly.

“Thank you for your reminder, Director Song,” said Wang Haoran.

Zheng Cong also said, “Sorry for the trouble, Director Song.”

Although the two of them said such words, their hearts were filled with pride.

“What’s the trouble?” Song Keling waved his hand. “I should be the one thanking you. It’s because of outstanding graduates like you that the students of Jiangbei University can find good jobs.”

At this moment, he suddenly noticed Hu Tian and Lin Fan standing beside him.

“Professor Hu, Professor Lin, you’re here too?”

Especially when he mentioned Professor Lin, Song Keling’s tone could not help but become excited.

Lin Fan had the highest status at Jiangbei University.

Even the chancellor was far inferior to him.

In the past, Jiangbei University was considered a well-known university in Hua Nation and was one of the top universities in the country.

However, compared to Huaqing University and Capital University, they were far inferior.

Now, Jiangbei University had become one of the top universities in the country in the world. Its reputation even surpassed Huaqing University and Capital University!

The reason for this was Lin Fan!

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran clearly did not notice the change in Song Keling’s tone.

Wang Haoran looked slightly better, but Zheng Cong was shocked.

Professor Lin?

Professor?

This young man was actually a professor!?

Then, Zheng Cong thought of how Lin Fan and Hu Tian were chatting and laughing earlier. They looked very intimate, and his heart tightened.

At this moment, Song Keling seemed to have thought of something. He quickly suppressed the excitement in his heart and said, “Director Zheng, Director Wang, the corporate meeting is about to start. Let’s go over first.”

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran nodded.

“Hu Tian, do you want to go with us?” Zheng Cong asked. “Perhaps you can choose some good jobs for your students in advance.”

Wang Haoran also said, “That’s right. Let’s go together. We’re old classmates. We can catch up on old times too.”

Their thoughts were very simple.

They had prepared a lot of information about their companies and their positions, but if they said it directly now, it would seem too deliberate.

However, it was reasonable to mention these things in the lecture hall.

They believed that when Hu Tian heard about how well they were doing, she would definitely look at them differently and be fascinated.

After all, outstanding men were the most handsome!

In addition, just as they had said, Hu Tian would definitely want her students to find good jobs.

In turn, this was a good opportunity for the two men to get in touch with her.

Before Hu Tian could answer, Song Keling, who was beside her, spoke first, “Don’t worry, Professor Hu is going over as well. Professor Hu is one of the representatives of the mathematics department at the conference.”

When Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran heard this, they both revealed a hint of joy.

Soon, Hu Tian would be able to truly realize how outstanding and handsome they were now!

Lin Fan said, “I’ll go too.”

When Song Keling heard this, his entire face was filled with smiles. “That’s great!”
